design: Same738 phase-entry histories, same96 fitting placements, same four ancestry-family folds, same three fixed E146 starting checkpoints. Compare continued observed-next-motion supervision against equal-weight observed plus all signed joint-probe targets. This controls for extra fitting updates and context selection. Probes are measured simulated transitions; no exact Jacobian labels or future input.
training: Each condition/fold/seed:1000 AdamW steps,lr1e-4,wd1e-4,batch128 histories,clip1,.001 log-weight regularization. Sample placements uniformly and histories uniformly within placement. Keep E146 training-only normalization, architecture, initial measured calibration prior, .98 recency and1e-6 ridge unchanged. Observed objective uses original next joint/tool motion. Mixed objective averages observed normalizedMSE and mean active-probe normalizedMSE equally. All three final Jacobians averaged; no best checkpoint/seed selection.
screen: Primary mixed ensemble: at least5% lower directional position MSE than fixed E146 on these histories; neither joint count directional error worse; directional rotation MSE<=1.05x; observed-next-motion position MSE<=1.05x. Also report observed-only fine-tuning to isolate dense-target effect. Passing permits complete fitting control only. E120 unchanged; held/fresh sets remain closed.
